title: Starter · Final Lap

environment.description: A packed oval speedway on a bright summer afternoon, high-banked asphalt, crowded grandstands, light towers, blue sky with a few clouds.
environment.style: Photoreal live-action motorsport broadcast. Crisp sunlight, heat shimmer, motion blur on wheels, saturated team colours.

entities.name: Infield grass
entities.notes: Mown infield grass with painted logo-free surface.

entities.name: Start-finish line
entities.notes: Checkered start-finish line painted across the track.

entities.name: Flag stand
entities.notes: Starter flag stand above the start-finish line; official waving a checkered flag.

entities.name: Press box
entities.notes: Glass-fronted press box and suites above the main grandstand.

entities.name: Light tower 1
entities.notes: Tall speedway floodlight tower: a steel lattice mast with a bank of floodlights at the top.

entities.name: Comfy car
entities.notes: Stock car race car in ComfyUI livery: electric blue body with bold yellow stripes and number 1, yellow wheels rims, the yellow Comfy wordmark on the hood and doors.

entities.name: Rival car
entities.notes: Stock car race car in a black and neon green livery, number 7, green accents, no real-world logos.

entities.name: Fan with phone
entities.notes: Excited race fan in a yellow Comfy cap and blue t-shirt, holding up a phone to film the finish.

entities.name: Front stretch 1
entities.notes: Banked asphalt racing surface, white lane lines, tyre rubber marks.

entities.name: Outer wall · front 1
entities.notes: SAFER barrier wall with catch fence.

shots.title: Final lap
shots.description: High aerial sweeping down behind @rival-car and @comfy-car as they exit turn four side by side onto the front stretch, the grandstands roaring.

shots.title: The draft
shots.description: Low tracking shot alongside as @comfy-car pulls out of @rival-car's draft and draws level.

shots.title: From the stands
shots.description: Handheld point of view from the front-stretch stands as @rival-car and @comfy-car thunder side by side toward the line, the crowd's arms in the bottom of frame.
